why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Myriad Earn page Open the Earn page and look through the open quests with the points each one pays. Finished quests are marked Completed.
2 Step 2 : Sign in to Myriad Use the Log in or Sign up window, which offers Continue with Google. Sign-up is described as free.

3 Step 3 : Complete an Engage to Earn quest Pick an open quest, such as "Vote for Myriad on the Abstract Portal" (10K+ points), and open its own page, linked from the Earn page, to see what the task is.
4 Step 4 : Optionally look through the markets For background on the app, open the markets list to see the questions it offers. Which Points or USD₮ markets you can use depends on your country.
5 Step 5 : Open the Points view on the leaderboard Open the leaderboard and select the Points view for SZN 3. The page shows Daily, Weekly, Monthly and All filters beside the tabs.
